title: Atlassian Audit Logs connector (Beta)
body:
The Atlassian Audit Logs connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

The connector ingests organization audit log events, such as user, security, and configuration changes, from Atlassian into Databricks. Authentication uses an Atlassian organization API key.

See [Atlassian Audit Logs connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/atlassian-audit-logs).
